stories.title: This 16-Year-Old Founded an AI Missile Startup. He’s Targeting ‘Cost per Kill’
stories.summary: Henrijs Dandzbergs dropped out of high school to join startup accelerator Y Combinator. With a new breed of missile, he wants to make killing as efficient as possible for the US and its military allies.
stories.zh_title: 這位 16 歲的年輕人創立了一家人工智慧飛彈新創公司。他的目標是“每次擊殺成本”
stories.zh_summary: Henrijs Dandzbergs 高中輟學，加入創業加速器 Y Combinator。他希望透過新型飛彈，讓美國及其軍事盟友盡可能有效率地進行殺戮。

stories.title: ‘More than just a game’: How GTA VI’s blockbuster launch fuels a booming content economy
stories.summary: GTA VI’s blockbuster launch is creating a wider economy around livestreams, social clips and high-volume content farms as millions tune in to watch others play.
stories.zh_title: 「不僅僅是一款遊戲」：GTA VI 的重磅發佈如何推動內容經濟的蓬勃發展
stories.zh_summary: 《GTA VI》的重磅發布正在圍繞直播、社交剪輯和大容量內容農場創造更廣泛的經濟，因為數百萬人會觀看其他人的遊戲。

stories.title: AI is changing software engineering — and some developers miss the struggle
stories.summary: AI coding tools are making software engineers faster, but developers tell CNBC the work has lost its "sense of joy and fun."
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧正在改變軟體工程——一些開發人員錯過了這場鬥爭
stories.zh_summary: 人工智慧編碼工具正在使軟體工程師變得更快，但開發人員告訴 CNBC，這項工作已經失去了「歡樂和樂趣」。

stories.title: Senate passes BAAJA permitting reform bill backed by AI, energy sectors
stories.summary: The permitting bill's Senate passage is a key step to it becoming law, but it would also need to clear the House before heading to President Trump's desk.
stories.zh_title: 參議院通過由人工智慧、能源部門支持的 BAAJA 許可改革法案
stories.zh_summary: 該法案在參議院獲得通過是其成為法律的關鍵一步，但在提交川普總統辦公桌之前還需要獲得眾議院的批准。

stories.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
stories.summary: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.
stories.zh_title: 蘋果可能正在開發自己的人工智慧代理來運行你的Mac
stories.zh_summary: 這家 iPhone 製造商似乎正在打造能夠與 Meta Muse、Instinct、Claude 和 OpenAI Dots 等公司競爭的代理商。

stories.title: These were the only stocks that rose amid the stock market’s wipeout Thursday
stories.summary: All 11 sectors of the S&P 500 declined — 10 of them by more than 1% — but cybersecurity stocks bucked the weakness.
stories.zh_title: 這些是周四股市暴跌中唯一上漲的股票
stories.zh_summary: 標準普爾 500 指數的所有 11 個板塊均下跌——其中 10 個板塊的跌幅超過 1%——但網路安全股卻逆勢上揚。

stories.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
stories.summary: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.
stories.zh_title: Google 讓 Gemini 能夠為您使用 Mac
stories.zh_summary: 谷歌對 Gemini 的最新更新為 Mac 帶來了一個人工智慧代理，可以組織文件、填寫表格和處理多步驟工作流程。

stories.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
stories.summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. […]
stories.zh_title: 蘋果正在招募工程師來建立自己的人工智慧代理
stories.zh_summary: 蘋果正在開發自己的人工智慧代理，它可以為你執行一系列任務，包括瀏覽網頁、跨應用程式工作、編寫程式碼和呼叫服務。這是根據彭博社發現的招聘清單顯示的，該清單稱蘋果正在尋找一名工程師來領導創建一個代理

stories.title: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
stories.summary: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but […]
stories.zh_title: Meta 的 Muse Charm 可能售價 300 美元
stories.zh_summary: 根據 The Information 報導，Meta 計劃將 Muse Charm 定價為 300 美元，這是一款帶有螢幕的小工具，可以讓你與 Muse AI 代理聊天。執行長馬克祖克柏今年稍早透露了這款小工具，並表示該公司預計將「在 12 月的假期前」發貨。

stories.title: Here's how big Anthropic’s record-setting IPO is: Visualization
stories.summary: The AI company sold 930 million shares at $83 each, the biggest initial public offering on record.
stories.zh_title: 以下是 Anthropic 創紀錄的 IPO 規模：
stories.zh_summary: 這家人工智慧公司以每股 83 美元的價格出售了 9.3 億股股票，這是有史以​​來最大的首次公開發行。

stories.title: Cramer says Nvidia’s woes are trumping Anthropic excitement for the rest of the AI trade
stories.summary: Jim Cramer warned that Nvidia's leadership crisis is overshadowing Anthropic's historic IPO.
stories.zh_title: 克萊默表示，英偉達的困境勝過人類對人工智慧產業其他領域的興奮
stories.zh_summary: Jim Cramer 警告說，Nvidia 的領導危機正在為 Anthropic 歷史性的 IPO 蒙上陰影。

stories.title: A CoreWeave co-founder just made an unconventional $30 million wager on its battered bonds
stories.summary: While executives typically buy shares to signal confidence, CoreWeave co-founder Brian Venturo is turning to the bond market to calm AI jitters.
stories.zh_title: CoreWeave 聯合創始人剛剛對其遭受重創的債券下了 3000 萬美元的非傳統賭注
stories.zh_summary: 雖然高階主管通常會購買股票來表達信心，但 CoreWeave 聯合創始人布萊恩·文圖羅 (Brian Venturo) 正在轉向債券市場來平息人工智慧的不安。

stories.title: Anthropic’s stock surges in its debut — and the rest of the market dives anyway
stories.summary: All four major U.S. stock indexes are now on pace for their worst week since President Trump’s “liberation day” tariffs of April 2025
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 的股價在首次亮相時飆升，而其他市場無論如何都在下跌
stories.zh_summary: 美國四大股指目前都將迎來自川普總統 2025 年 4 月「解放日」關稅以來最糟糕的一周

stories.title: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
stories.summary: "We've got this," Colette Kress, interim CEO of Nvidia, said Tuesday night as she closed out the embattled chip company's third quarter earnings call. By Thursday, the company's stock price was hovering at around $150 per share, a nearly 40 percent drop from its all-time high on October 6th, and wiping out a brief post-earnings […]
stories.zh_title: 英偉達近期股價波動簡史
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達臨時執行長科萊特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)週二晚間在結束這家陷入困境的晶片公司第三季度財報電話會議時表示：「我們已經做到了。」截至週四，該公司股價徘徊在每股 150 美元左右，較 10 月 6 日創下的歷史高點下跌近 40%，跌幅也達到了 150 美元/股。

stories.title: What’s With All These Outages?
stories.summary: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” we discuss the outages that have swept digital life over the past week, where new money from Anthropic’s IPO is going, and the AI chip world post-Jensen Huang.
stories.zh_title: 所有這些中斷是怎麼回事？
stories.zh_summary: 在本週的「恐怖谷」節目中，我們將討論過去一周席捲數位生活的宕機事件、Anthropic IPO 帶來的新資金的去向，以及黃仁勳之後的人工智慧晶片世界。

stories.title: Nvidia’s stock falls further. It has lost $669 billion in six trading days.
stories.summary: There are only 20 companies in the world with a market capitalization of $669 billion or higher
stories.zh_title: 英偉達的股價進一步下跌。六個交易日內損失了 6,690 億美元。
stories.zh_summary: 全球市值達到或超過 6,690 億美元的公司僅有 20 家

stories.title: Palo Alto stock jumps on earnings beat and company's big bet on securing open-weight models
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks reported better-than-expected first-quarter results and inked a $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute
stories.zh_title: 帕洛阿爾托股票因盈利增長和公司對開放權重模型的大賭注而上漲
stories.zh_summary: Palo Alto Networks 公佈第一季業績優於預期，並與人工智慧新創公司 Applied Compute 簽署了 45 億美元的交易

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
stories.summary: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic的IPO讓AI的循環融資熱潮經受考驗
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic 在上市時面臨著巨大的計算承諾，但即使 Anthropic 失去領先地位，其最大的基礎設施合作夥伴（包括亞馬遜和谷歌）也可以繼續從人工智慧中獲利。
